title: The Quiet Dog
briefing: A necklace is gone from the study at Harrow House. The window latch is broken, and everyone assumes a burglar came in from the garden. You are not so sure.

atoms.W: The thief came in through the window
atoms.M: There is mud on the study carpet

statements.speaker: Gardener
statements.text: Anyone who came in through that window had to cross the garden.

statements.speaker: Housekeeper
statements.text: If anyone crosses the garden at night, the dog barks.

clues.text: The neighbour was awake all night and heard no barking.
There is mud on the study carpet.

conclusion.text: The thief did not come in through the window.
